Description: Acoustic characterization of the two released soundscape stimuli, measured on the exact .wav files in this folder.

sample_rate_hz.Description: Sampling rate of the audio file.

integrated_loudness_lufs.Description: Programme loudness, EBU R128 / ITU-R BS.1770 integrated, in LUFS. The two clips differ by 5.43 LU; they were presented as delivered, without normalization or condition-specific gain.

peak_dbfs.Description: Maximum absolute sample value in dB relative to full scale.

rms_dbfs.Description: Root-mean-square level of the mono sum in dBFS.

crest_factor_db.Description: Peak minus RMS, in dB; higher values indicate a more transient, less dense signal.

spectral_centroid_hz.Description: Mean spectral centroid over 2048-sample Hann frames; higher values correspond to a brighter timbre.

md5.Description: MD5 checksum of the audio file as released.
